columns.name: room
columns.defaultConstraints: UNIQUE REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: UNIQUE REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rooms" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nick" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "avatar" TEXT NULL, "cover" TEXT NULL, "area" TEXT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "online_viewers" INTEGER NULL, "popularity" INTEGER NULL, "total_viewers" INTEGER NULL, "followers" INTEGER NULL, "last_status" TEXT NULL, "last_live_at" INTEGER NULL, "extra" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("platform", "room_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "follows" ("room" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "followed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', PRIMARY KEY ("room"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "follow_areas" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "namespace" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "area_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "area_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "type_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "area_pic" TEXT NULL, "short_name" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("platform", "namespace", "area_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_folded" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "room_tags" ("room" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("room", "tag"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "room" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "last_watched_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "block_rules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_folded" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("kind", "value_folded"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "room_prefs" ("room" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("room", "key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "iptv_playlists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_agent" TEXT NULL, "auto_sync" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_sync" IN (0, 1)), "guide_url" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "iptv_channels" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "playlist" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES iptv_playlists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "tvg_id" TEXT NULL, "tvg_name" TEXT NULL, "logo" TEXT NULL, "catchup_mode" TEXT NULL, "catchup_source" TEXT NULL, "catchup_days" REAL NULL, "catchup_correction" REAL NULL, "headers" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "iptv_guide_sources" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "auto_sync" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_sync" IN (0, 1)), "selected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("selected" IN (0, 1)), "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "iptv_guide_channels" ("source" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES iptv_guide_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "names" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "icon" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source", "channel_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "iptv_programmes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES iptv_guide_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stop" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "catchup_id" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_history" ("keyword_folded" TEXT NOT NULL, "keyword" TEXT NOT NULL, "searched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("keyword_folded"));
CREATE INDEX iptv_channels_name ON iptv_channels (name)
CREATE INDEX iptv_channels_group ON iptv_channels (playlist, group_name, position)
CREATE INDEX iptv_programmes_channel ON iptv_programmes (source, channel_id, start)
CREATE INDEX iptv_programmes_stop ON iptv_programmes (stop)
